creative_direction: Build a mountain gorge around a narrow white waterfall descending through layered ink cliffs. Use a foreground pine branch to frame one side without crossing the bright water. The cliff planes should alternate dry charcoal texture and diluted cool-gray washes, with restrained moss-green touches on sheltered ledges. At the base, a small pool catches the falling water as a pale oval. Keep the waterfall and its enclosing rock silhouette dominant, while smaller roots and rock fissures reward closer viewing. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
